title: Baked Fish Stew
description: A hearty Italian-inspired stew featuring fish as the main protein, cooked in a flavorful broth with a hint of Croatian flair.
instructions: Season the fish with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the fish until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the fish from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the chopped onion to the pot. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the fermented Croatian paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, white wine, and chopped parsley to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the fish to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
